response.overview: A maritime procession in honor of Saint Peter departs from a beach in Cabedelo, passes through the estuary of the Paraíba River, and ends at Jacaré River Beach. The voice-over narration adopts an “institutional” tone, praising the fishermen’s popular cultural expressions – such as the Cambindas of Lucena and Coco Praieiro – describing them as folkloric, religious, and secular manifestations.
response.title: Misticismo - Folguedos e Tradições
